purpose: Offline evaluation policy only; not a production scoring policy.

VIEW.rationale: Weak discovery intent; capped and session-deduplicated.
VIEW.risk: Repeated browsing and bots can inflate it.

CAPPED_REPEAT_VIEW.rationale: A small increase for distinct capped view opportunities.
CAPPED_REPEAT_VIEW.risk: No session identifier exists, so a UTC-day proxy is used.

LIKE.risk: Current tables retain active state, not full history.

SAVE.rationale: Explicit project intent to return later.
SAVE.risk: Active state is available; historical unsaves are only partial through attribution.

FOLLOW.rationale: Sustained project interest, below a completed outcome.
FOLLOW.risk: Follow history is not retained in the active table.

RESERVATION_CREATED.rationale: Strong material intent, but not a successful outcome.
RESERVATION_CREATED.risk: Pending, rejected, expired, and cancelled requests must not be equivalent.

RESERVATION_ACCEPTED.rationale: Supplier acceptance indicates materially stronger intent.
RESERVATION_ACCEPTED.risk: Acceptance can still fail to complete.

RESERVATION_COMPLETED.rationale: Closest current proxy for successful reuse.
RESERVATION_COMPLETED.risk: Completion is sparse and still not a direct reuse-quality label.

PROJECT_BUILD_STARTED.rationale: Strong project intent represented by a durable build operation.

PROJECT_BUILD_PROGRESS.rationale: Meaningful checklist progress is stronger than a start.
PROJECT_BUILD_PROGRESS.risk: Repeated item updates can be noisy.

PROJECT_BUILD_COMPLETED.risk: Very sparse in the current seed/local population.

UNLIKE_OR_REVERSAL.rationale: Resolve as removal of the active positive; do not treat it as universal dislike.
UNLIKE_OR_REVERSAL.risk: Only attributed reversal history is available.

CANCELLATION_OR_FAILURE.rationale: Contextual negative outcome, not a categorical item dislike.
CANCELLATION_OR_FAILURE.risk: Cancellation reason and supplier-side failure can mean different things.

IMPRESSION_WITHOUT_ACTION.rationale: Exposure is not a dislike; it can be used as a bounded evaluation negative after a window.
IMPRESSION_WITHOUT_ACTION.risk: Exposure bias and missing visibility signals.
